Subject: Finova: Decision criteria - latency/cost/SLA follow-up

Hi Sofia / Ken —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps below.

Recap:
- Primary decision criteria: latency targets for embedding/nearest-neighbor queries, per-token cost targets for large-scale batch inference, and deployment mode (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private/VPC).
- Security & procurement: Finova needs SOC 2 scope, legal review, and a standard procurement PO/terms. Estimated procurement lead time: 4–6 weeks.
- Estimated scale: ~200M embeddings/month and ~1B tokens of generative traffic in peak months.

Questions / clarifications we promised to capture:
1) Latency target: you mentioned sub-120ms p50 for production search flows — can you confirm p50 vs p95 target and which endpoint this applies to (embeddings vs chat/generation)?
2) Cost target: is there a target $/embedding or a monthly committed spend range we should use for pricing guidance?
3) Deployment preference: are you leaning to Hosted API for speed of onboarding, or Dedicated/Private for data isolation and SLA-backed performance?

Next steps:
- We'll send a short pricing & SLA estimate (attached) that includes Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private line items and expected latency ranges.
- Can you share the economic buyer and legal/procurement contacts so we can include them in the procurement timeline? (Name + email + any PO process notes.)
- Proposed follow-up: 30-minute call on Wed Mar 6 to review the estimate and align on procurement timeline. Please send availability.

Attachments:
- redwood-inference-sla-pricing-estimate.pdf (pricing + SLO ranges)
- po_template.docx (redwood PO + billing info template)

Thanks — happy to iterate.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
(415) 555-0147

From: Sofia Martinez <sofia.martinez@finova.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Ken Park <ken.park@finova.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Mar 2028 09:38:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Finova: Decision criteria - latency/cost/SLA follow-up

Marissa —

Thanks for the clear recap. A few answers below:

- Latency: Our primary production requirement is embeddings for semantic search. Target is p50 <= 100ms and p95 <= 250ms for single-query embeddings at our expected QPS. For generation/chat we have a looser target (p50 <= 400ms).
- Cost: We don't have a hard $/embedding yet but the finance team is looking at an annual committed spend in the $200k–$400k range for the initial rollout. Please give both committed and pay-as-you-go pricing scenarios.
- Deployment: Security is a high priority for us. We're leaning toward Dedicated or Private (VPC) depending on cost and SLA. If the Hosted option can meet the latency/SLA with contractual controls, that would be easiest — otherwise Dedicated.

Economic buyer / procurement / legal:
- Angela Ruiz <angela.ruiz@finova.com> — CFO (economic buyer)
- Tom Nguyen <tom.nguyen@finova.com> — Procurement lead (PO process)
- Meera Shah <meera.shah@finova.com> — Legal (contract review)

Procurement notes: Standard SOW with PO. Our procurement team requires SOC 2 Type II and a reviewed DPA. Timeline: procurement + legal review typically 3–6 weeks after we have final pricing.

Availability for Wed Mar 6: I'm free 10:00–11:00am PT, Ken can do 11:00–11:30. If you need Angela in the first meeting, she prefers later mornings.

Thanks — attaching our standard security checklist in a follow-up if helpful.

Best,
Sofia

Marissa — quick note on the technical and contracting asks:

- Latency: For embeddings at Finova's scale we can hit p50 ~50–90ms on Dedicated with NVLink-connected GPUs and tuned batching. Hosted can be ~80–140ms depending on QPS and prefix caching; we should surface p50/p95 ranges per deployment in the estimate.
- Pricing: I'll prepare a Dedicated pricing sheet that includes reserved capacity (monthly commit) vs burst usage, plus PAYG Hosted numbers. We'll itemize embeddings vs generation unit economics.
- Security/procurement: I'll attach our SOC2 overview. We should also offer to start the security questionnaire now — I'll loop in Solutions Engineering if Finova wants a technical review call.

Attachments:
- SOC2-overview.pdf

I'll draft the Dedicated scenarios and share an internal price band by EOD today so Marissa can push to Sofia/Angela.

Thanks,
Marcus
